_comment: Edit(path) rules cover ALL file-editing tools including Write; Write(path) rules are
NOT evaluated, so every deny below is expressed as Edit(...).
Bash allows are broad on the project's own venv python deliberately. The first live
run was blocked from sending its own state-mismatch alert because narrow per-module
patterns didn't match what it tried to run. An agent that cannot raise an alarm when
something is wrong is more dangerous than one with slightly wider shell access —
especially since the deny list below still protects every safety-critical file, and
orders can only be placed through engine.execute, which re-validates independently.
